blurb: Warm cream, terracotta and soft serif: handmade, human and hospitable.

direction.name: Warm Craft
direction.thesis: A welcoming, human place: cream paper, terracotta and a soft serif, with simple arches and suns drawn as flat shapes instead of stock imagery.
direction.grid: Two generous columns on desktop with the shape composition on the right; sections use rounded surface panels on the cream background with 24px+ padding.
direction.hero: Soft serif headline left; right, a composition of flat arches and a sun drawn in terracotta, sand and olive that echoes the product's character.
direction.imagery: Warm, natural-light photography when real photos exist; otherwise flat shape compositions in the palette. No glossy renders.
direction.motion: Shapes settle in with a gentle 400ms rise; buttons depress slightly on press. Reduced motion shows the final state.
direction.voice: Warm, first-person plural, plain words. Names of people and places over abstractions.
direction.signature: The stacked arch composition behind the headline's right edge.
